_comment: Model per agent for both adapters. Pick a profile at build time: FORGE_MODELS=balanced npm test (default: rigor). Claude Code gets the alias as-is. OMP gets the matching `omp` selector as the agent's default `model:` (exact id first, bare alias as fallback); users still change it in OMP /agents, and install.sh keeps already-installed agent files. Forge agents: forge-code-reviewer (QA, every run) and forge-plan-critic (PLAN, only with /forge planreview on); the main agent plans, executes, verifies and writes delivery itself.
